caption: The drawing depicts two men sitting at a table. Both are dressed in blue coats with yellow or tan trousers and black boots. One man, seated on the left, holds a fork and is turned slightly toward the table, while the other man, on the right, raises a glass in his hand as if to drink. The table between them is round, with a decanter containing a red liquid, two plates of food, and a loaf of bread or pie in the center. Each man has a white napkin or paper in front of him on the table. Two hats are shown: a black hat with a feather hanging on the left and a plain black top hat on the right, both floating above or behind the figures. The background is a light brown or tan color with a patterned floor comprising green, red, and beige. The upper border contains the words "STRANGERS RESORT" in large capital letters, and the bottom border has the name "J. CARTER" in gold or yellowish letters. The overall style is flat and decorative with a limited color palette, focusing on blue, yellow, brown, black, green, red, and beige tones. The rectangular image is surrounded by a simple, light-colored frame.
title: Inn Sign: "J. Carter" (recto)
